phase0.heading: The pipeline is live
phase0.intro: This is a deliberately plain technical placeholder, not a design. It exists to prove the foundations work before any screen is built. The visual direction is chosen by the client in Phase 1.

checks.deploy: The repository builds and deploys automatically.
checks.locale: Both languages are served from their own address.
checks.direction: The page direction flips with the language.
checks.tokens: Brand values come from design tokens, not hardcoded colours.
checks.mobile: The layout reflows down to a 320px-wide phone.

phase0.nextBody: Phase 2: turning the approved look into reusable building blocks and the app shell, so every screen after it is consistent and quick to build.
phase0.tokenWarning: These are the approved colours — direction C, chosen by the client. The logo is still a stand-in until the vector file arrives.
